# KaTeX 0.16.47 (MIT, Khan Academy and contributors)

Vendored for `web/theory.html`: `katex.min.js`, `contrib/auto-render.min.js`, and `katex.min.css` built from the
release's `katex-swap.min.css` with the font sources reduced to woff2 (the woff and ttf files are not shipped).
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/katex/v/0.16.47
